descriptionChirho: The latter part or final period of a timeframe, especially eschatological ('in the latter days,' 'in the end of days').
The final outcome, result, or fate of a person, nation, or situation, often with moral or judicial overtones ('his end,' 'their end,' 'your latter end').
A future or hopeful expectation, especially the assured good outcome promised by God (Jer 29:11 'a future and a hope'; Prov 23:18, 24:14).
Offspring or descendants; those who come after a person, their future progeny or lineage.
The remaining portion of a people or group; survivors left after judgment or catastrophe.
The spatial extreme or farthest reaches of a territory or domain ('the uttermost parts').
